scenarios.name: v3 initializes with five tracks, four persistent library tabs and two advisory checks
Right-click edits the clicked clip at pointer time
Shift+F10, typeahead, arrows, submenu return and restored focus
Object-specific menus plus visible More and outside dismissal
Locked commands expose disabled state and preserve footage
Menus stay in viewport; native text menus remain native
Shift multi-selection survives a right-click
Grouped copy/paste remaps attachments and is one undo
Group drag keeps relative timing and original tracks
Group nudge at time zero clamps the group, not individual members
Grouping and ungrouping preserve transitions and alignment
Batch fade and explicit mute/unmute controls work
Speed retimes source-linked annotations, split and following clips
Speed guard rejects overlaps, grouped retiming and active crossfades
Color controls, look paste, rotation and flips preserve source timing
Aspect ratio changes real output size and keeps circular webcam geometry
Safe intro insertion shifts every track atomically and respects locks
Local cards provide editable text and duration
Real still image import and media search
SRT/VTT parsing preserves text and maps source-linked caption speed
Caption dialog validates timing and preserves open appearance controls
Caption text split and clip split conserve timing
Actionable checks flag video gaps, audio solo and hard-to-read captions
Caption/callout collision has a working corrective action
Opaque privacy cover is undoable and warns about originals in project packages
Save status distinguishes download request from dirty edits and cache
Gap cleanup does not silently break cross-track groups
Go to and fit selection connect the timeline with its preview
Strict extended schema and v2 migration
Workspace reopens with speed, color, captions, group selection and format
Batch source reconnection restores media without changing the edit
Ambiguous reconnect candidates are not chosen automatically
Portable image project includes real bytes and reopens them
Review-range controls reject invalid bounds and allow a short range
Support diagnostics omit names, paths, captions, frames and audio
Five desktop/compact layouts retain preview and avoid page overflow
No unhandled browser exceptions
No external media, font or API requests
